system.description:
CLASS UNLIVING

Prerequisites Level 4

The pulse of life shines to you like a lantern in a crypt.

You gain Life Sense. If you already have Life Sense, you instead gain a +2 racial bonus to Perception checks made to locate living or undead creatures with Life Sense.

Grants Life Sense. If you already had it (an Unliving Zombie), +2 racial is offered on Perception checks to locate living or undead creatures with it — tick it then.

conditionals.label: Sense the Living
conditionals.scope: Perception to locate living or undead creatures with Life Sense — only if you had Life Sense before this feat
